messages.subject: Seed pod issue
messages.text:
Hi, 

 I had ordered quite a few pods and planted them and 0 have sprouted. Its been 4 weeks maybe a little longer for some of them. I planted in multiple locations.
 

 Is there a reason for this? I had also gifted some to my mother and none of hers have sprouted either.
 

 Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Seed pod issue
messages.text:
Never received a response to this. Kind of crappy to spend over $100 and not get one single plant.

messages.subject: Re: Seed pod issue
messages.text:
Hi,

We've left you without an answer for way too long on this, especially after spending over $100. That's not the experience we want anyone to have with us, and I'm sorry.

Four weeks with nothing sprouting across multiple locations, including your mother's, is not normal. A few things can affect germination: planting depth (the seeds need to sit very shallowly, no more than 5mm under the surface), soil temperature (germination really kicks in once it stays consistently above 20°C for several days), and steady moisture. That said, when nothing comes up in two separate locations, it points more to the batch than to anything you did.

We'd like to make this right by reshipping your order at no charge. Is the shipping address still the same one on your order?

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
